turns.text: Um, he is getting on a bit.
Yeah, so that's my favorite way to spend my free time and unwind.
turns.zh: 对，所以那是我空闲时最喜欢用来放松的方式。

turns.text: Okay, so what made it better?
turns.zh: 好，那是什么让它变得更好呢？

turns.text: A lot of the same things.
One of the first things is, very often we say, "I usually do this." "I usually do that." You can change that.
turns.zh: 首先呢，我们经常说「我通常做这个」「我通常做那个」，你可以换一种说法。

turns.text: take my dog for a walk." Or, "I typically take my dog for a walk." Okay?
turns.zh: 「遛狗。」或者，「我一般会去遛狗。」好吗？
